purpose: Product utilization is evaluated in fixed 900-second wall-clock windows, independent of worker boundaries, using substantive durable evidence rather than heartbeat-only writes.

windows.basis: A stricter re-audit excluded ACTIVITY-only heartbeat commits. Coverage amount was sufficient, but one substantive-evidence gap was 125 seconds, exceeding the 120-second acceptance contract by 5 seconds.

Epoch 18 remained productively active well beyond the nominal quarter boundary but stopped producing meaningful durable progress at 01:25:08 without a committed successor. No evidence exists for the remaining 292 seconds of this fixed window, so the window fails regardless of the earlier healthy span.

Cold rescue arrived too late for a single non-overlapping worker to reach 840 seconds inside this fixed window. Continue useful work anyway and measure recovery separately rather than manufacturing a pass.

acceptance: Three consecutive audited fixed windows with >=840 seconds useful coverage and <=120-second substantive durable-evidence gaps establish the initial P0 utilization pass. Heartbeat-only commits never satisfy the gap contract.
